jobs.title: Strategic Planning Specialist I
jobs.description:
If you have what it takes to become part of the Vistra family and would like to start a promising career with a global leader, take a look at the exciting employment opportunities that are currently available and apply online.

Job Summary
As part of the Strategic Planning and Performance Management team, the Specialist I is responsible for managing customer acquisition & retention budget & transaction planning for the Residential line of business. The successful candidate will have strong experience in sourcing, structuring, modeling, analyzing, and interpreting complex data sets into presentation and/or dashboard reporting for leadership. This role works closely with marketing channel owners and the finance teams to evaluate opportunities, set targets for go to market strategies and build counts and financial variance narratives

Job Description
Key Accountabilities
•Lead collaborative process to develop robust, marketing transaction and budget forecasts that reflect thoughtful strategic planning, collaboration/coordination with channel managers, financial discipline and creative thinking
•Design and implement data models and simulations to forecast trends and patterns using advanced analysis and tools such as Python and integrate into repeatable dashboard (Tableau/ Power BI)
•Identify areas of improvement and implement solutions to streamline, integrate and automate processes using advanced analytics tools to improve efficiency and accuracy
•Calculate and forecast profitability of campaigns; perform sensitivity analysis for key assumptions and market scenarios
•Prepare business case evaluations—including NPV, ROI, and Customer Lifetime Value analyses to provide cost-benefit recommendations on channel proposals and initiatives
•Create and lead management presentations on campaign and channel-specific key drivers/metrics/performance to optimize channel mix and spend

Education, Experience & Skill Requirements
• 7 years of work experience in quantitative business functions such as FP&A, Data Science, Revenue Management or Business Intelligence
• Experience gained thru college degree or certifications is applicable to above skills (Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years or Master’s with 4+ years or equivalent 7+ years)
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business or Data Analytics preferred
• Must have advanced experience in data modeling, SQL and/or Snowflake, Python and data visualization tools (Tableau/Power BI)
Prompt engineering experience is a plus

Key Metrics
•Excellent analytical, problem-solving organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to work independently, proactively pursue business growth opportunities as a self-starter, and manage diverse range of projects simultaneously
•Ability to gain content knowledge quickly and a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a rapidly changing environment
•On time and accurate delivery and development of insightful forecasts, marketing spend tracking and transaction planning
•Strong oral and written communication skills, good presentation skills, and excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work comfortably with all levels of employees, management and leadership
•Track record of working cross functionally and holding other teams accountable for on-time and accurate contributions to processes
•Ability to leverage advanced analytics tools to convert large complex data into actionable business insights via dashboard visualization

Job Family
Marketing

Company
Vistra Retail Operations Company

Locations
Irving, Texas

Texas We are a company of people committed to:  Exceeding Customer Expectations, Great People, Teamwork, Competitive Spirit and Effective Communication.  If this describes you, then apply today!

If you currently work for Vistra or its subsidiaries, please apply via the internal career site.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager Financial Planning & Analysis System, Technology
jobs.description:
If you have what it takes to become part of the Vistra family and would like to start a promising career with a global leader, take a look at the exciting employment opportunities that are currently available and apply online.

Job Summary
The Senior Manager – Financial Planning & Analysis Systems is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end FP&A technology portfolio. The position serves as the primary liaison between FP&A and IT, and external delivery partners translating finance priorities into scalable solutions across SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and SAP Datasphere. The role architects and optimizes planning models, data pipelines, dashboards, and executive reporting to support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic decision-making while ensuring reliable operations, disciplined enhancement delivery, and effective vendor performance.

Job Description
Key Accountabilities
• Own and optimize the full FP&A systems portfolio and roadmap.
• Partner with finance, Delivery and Data teams to convert business needs into system requirements and technology solutions. Provide functional direction and delivery governance for vendor partners performing application maintenance and application development, while retaining internal accountability for outcomes.
• Design and maintain SAC planning models, calculations, allocations, dashboards, executive stories, workflows, security, and data controls.
• Architect the financial data layer in SAP Datasphere, including data ingestion, transformations, analytical datasets, and semantic models.
• Integrate SAP S/4HANA, legacy ERP platforms, and non-SAP data sources.
• Protect financial data integrity and enforce governance standards.
• Lead the development of documentation, training materials, and end-user enablement programs.
• Monitor vendor service levels, delivery quality, capacity, risks, dependencies, and financial performance; facilitate governance reviews and drive timely escalation and remediation.
• Collaborate with Finance, IT, Basis, and Infrastructure teams on system capacity, performance, and governance.

Education, Experience & Skill Requirements
• Experience gained through college degree programs in Finance, Accounting, MIS, Data Analytics
• 5+ years of experience in corporate FP&A, financial systems, or enterprise data management.
• 2–3+ years of hands-on experience configuring and supporting SAC Planning and SAP Datasphere. Advanced SAC expertise in planning models, dimensions, Data Actions, advanced formulas, allocations, workflows, security, and live/import connections.
• Strong understanding of financial statements, forecasting, allocations, consolidations, and multi-currency processes.
• Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions, maintain high data accuracy, and communicate effectively with technical teams and executive stakeholders.
• Experience directing managed-service and development vendors, including work intake, prioritization, scope and estimate review, delivery governance, service-level management, and quality assurance.

Key Metrics
• Accuracy and reconciliation of financial data across ERP, Datasphere, and SAC.
• Budgeting and forecasting cycle completion time. And Forecast timeliness and accuracy.
• SAC dashboard and planning-model performance.
• Data pipeline reliability and successful refresh or replication rates.
• Number and severity of production defects or data discrepancies.
• SIT and UAT completion and defect-resolution rates.
• System availability and issue-resolution time.
• User adoption, training completion, and stakeholder satisfaction.
• Delivery of planned enhancements against the FP&A systems roadmap
• Vendor achievement of service-level agreements, including response, resolution, and backlog-aging targets.
• On-time, within-budget delivery of vendor-led enhancements and development releases.

Job Family
Information Technology

Company
Vistra Corporate Services Company

Locations
Irving, Texas

jobs.title: Major Projects - Operations Manager
jobs.description:
If you have what it takes to become part of the Vistra family and would like to start a promising career with a global leader, take a look at the exciting employment opportunities that are currently available and apply online.

Job Summary
The Major Projects Operations Manager is responsible for managing and completing the operations scope of a major project at Beaver Valley and fleet project support. This role ensures technical excellence, regulatory compliance, and successful integration of all systems into existing plant infrastructure.

Job Description
Key Accountabilities
- Provide Operations oversight and technical direction for all design, modification, and testing activities.
- Coordinate all interconnecting modifications to ensure system compatibility and operational readiness between Vistra and the Contractors.
- Direct and approve Operations reviews, ensuring alignment with nuclear safety and licensing requirements.
- Manage and guide support contract organization to maintain quality, scope, and schedule compliance.
- Manage and Lead Independent Operational Reviews to validate design integrity, constructability, and compliance with nuclear standards.
- Interface with regulatory bodies, internal stakeholders, and external contractors to ensure all engineering deliverables meet NRC and INPO requirements.
- Drive resolution of technical issues, ensuring timely decision-making to support project milestones.
- Ensure system designs consider long-term operability, maintainability, and integration with plant operations to include online and offline impacts, procedures, training, turnover and commissioning.

Education, Experience, & Skill Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering
- 15 years of engineering experience in nuclear power, with at least 5 years in a leadership role
- Shift Technical Advisor (STA) qualified
- Required experience with Ops Impacts, evaluations, training, procedures, site coordination, and Beaver Valley site processes
- Strong knowledge of NRC regulations, INPO guidelines, and industry standards
- Demonstrated ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams on high-complexity projects
- Available for travel for project support

Key Metrics
- On-time delivery of milestones.
- Compliance with all nuclear safety, licensing, and quality requirements.
- Successful completion of independent reviews with minimal corrective actions.
- Effective coordination between project site leadership, 0perations, contractors, and third parties.

Plant Operations

jobs.title: Associate Category Manager
jobs.description:
If you have what it takes to become part of the Vistra family and would like to start a promising career with a global leader, take a look at the exciting employment opportunities that are currently available and apply online.

Job Summary
The Associate Category Manager develops, implements and manages strategic category strategies in support of Vistra’s objectives. This position will deliver year-over-year value to the business through supplier service level, reliability, demand and strategic cost improvements. The Associate Category Manager will demonstrate the ability to learn and understand various supply chain functions and activities to be capable of self-sufficiency with necessary tools required to perform daily tasks. This position will serve as a leader within supply chain ensuring effective communication, knowledge transfer and practical application of tools to execute strategies. The Associate Category Manager will maintain internal relationships to ensure strategy implementation is in accordance with stakeholder expectations.

The position is being posted with the Royal Lane Office as the primary office location; however, consideration for officing at other Vistra locations will given for qualified candidates with existing Vistra Supply Chain experience.

Job Description
Key Accountabilities

- Develop and implement key category strategies for high impact, usage and/or spend areas

- Develop and maintain key supplier relationships for category responsibilities.

- Develop performance metrics and hold suppliers accountable for deliverables.

- Initiate, plan and execute strategic business reviews for key categories.

- Collaborate effectively, deliver timely information and provide recommendations

- Develop and maintain key stakeholder relationships to ensure that centrally driven strategies align with business objectives.

- Support and promote Vistra’s Supplier Diversity program through outreach and supplier development activities.

- Track performance within each spend category and measure value directly attributed to budgets along with other forms of value creation

- Develop category insights and proactively communicate updates to stakeholders, colleagues and management

- Lead the process to select and manage suppliers, leading to various project and or recurring contract awards

- Develop commercial value propositions to compliment technical needs across multiple spend categories

- P erform procurement processes including but not limited to contracting, PO transactions, safety and insurance qualifications

Education, Experience & Skill Requirements

- 3+ years Category Management experience or 5 years of sourcing and procurement experience

- Has solid knowledge and ability to define a simple category, to run spend/usage/market analysis, and develop the appropriate category strategy and benefit analysis.

- Proficient sourcing practitioner that demonstrates solid knowledge and ability to apply the sourcing process including conducting all preparation activities (data, demand & market analysis) and running e-Sourcing projects

- Expert negotiator that can lead large cross-functional negotiation teams and negotiate across multiple negotiation points

- Demonstrates a strong understanding of the practical and risk impacts of contract terms and conditions and proficient at managing the red line contracting process

- Demonstrates a strong understanding of financial statements and ability of apply total costs methods including TCO estimations, NPV models, should-cost models

- Proficient at managing projects and associated activities including work plans, risk registers, stakeholder management, business case development, etc.

- Independently plans and implements strategies within scope of responsibility that advance supply chain goals and support the vision and mission.

- High school diploma or equivalent

- Experience gained through college degree programs and/or certifications is applicable to above skills

Key Metrics

- Budgetary improvements realized through commercial, reliability and productivity levers through recurring and standalone projects

- Improved operational performance including transactional automation, process improvements, relationship development and issue resolution

- Mentoring, nurturing and promoting the inclusion of small and diverse businesses through competitive and growth opportunities

- Manage supplier risk and performance including safety through regular business reviews and learning events to identify corrective actions

Job Family
Supply Chain

Company
Luminant Generation Company LLC

Locations
Royal Lane Office
